## What's new

Threadnote 5.2.0-beta.6 refreshes its runtime, parser, and AI integration foundations with security updates while preserving reliable local indexing, MCP connections, and telemetry.

- Updated Threadnote's JavaScript, native inference, parser, and Python reranker dependencies to current compatible releases, resolving the project's reported dependency audit findings.
- MCP connections retain their negotiated protocol checks and reject incompatible sessions clearly after the SDK update.
- Code-graph indexing uses the matching Tree-sitter runtime and parser assets for more dependable analysis across supported languages.
- Telemetry continues to preserve its privacy and consent controls while producing the current OpenTelemetry resource and scope format.

[Full changelog since 5.2.0-beta.5](https://github.com/threadnote/threadnote/compare/v5.2.0-beta.5...v5.2.0-beta.6)
